coverage: Named roster: 2014 DMG ch.5 'Settlements' pp.112-114 FETCHED raw (archive.org full-book OCR, _djvu.txt) and cross-checked against a second book-text mirror and Sly Flourish's page-numbered table index; 2014 DMG ch.1 'Settlements' pp.15-20 FETCHED raw - the correction that matters is that the publisher's settlement PROSE doctrine lives in ch.1, not ch.5, and no 'Government' table sits on p.112 (Forms of Government is a d100 table on p.18). 2024 DMG 'Settlements' FETCHED complete and free from the licensed Roll20 compendium, so the sidebar and all seven tables were read at the primary rather than through Screen Rant; the 2024 'Free City of Greyhawk' and 'Greyhawk Gazetteer' pages came the same way and are the publisher's own worked settlement prose. Wizards' free Settlement Tracker PDF FETCHED - it is the exact slot list the angle asked for (name / size band / defining trait / claim to fame / current calamity / local leader / noteworthy people / noteworthy places / GP value of the most expensive item). SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1 FETCHED as PDFs and grepped: both carry NO settlement section and none of the tables, so none of this doctrine is CC-BY. BLOCKED: dndbeyond.com DMG compendium pages (entitlement-gated, redirect to the shop), 5e.tools (403), fandom (403), dokumen.pub (403), anyflip (403), dmsguild.com live (403, recovered via Wayback). NOT FOUND: any Wayback capture of a wizards.com article on describing settlements; Perkins' 'Dungeon Master Experience' archive is gone. Substantive per route: 6 publisher primaries, 2 CC-BY SRD measurements, 1 publisher-platform craft article, 6 critic/analysis/reception pages, 1 vendor page for the unpublished House Style Guide - 20 substantive sources, 68 claims, every quotation string-matched against the fetched text before writing.
